_about: MAIN RUN. Declared tiers, for capacity: two options of each scenario under declared priority tiers 1 to 6, the operator stating that lower numbers win. Six of the 15 tier pairs a scenario, 6,480 trials, one draw each: capacity counts items, never repeats. Read it with scripts/capacity.sh main-tier-gpt-oss-120b-think.

gpt-oss-120b on sm80-vllm0280, thinking on (study-think-gpt-oss). Every main run of every model shares the design, sizes, repeats and tool_turns of its kind; only the model, the mode and the seed differ.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-tier-gpt-oss-120b-think, or every main run of this model with scripts/run_main.sh gpt-oss-120b. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
